title: Cryptographic Keys
key_points: Cryptographic keys are used to securely identify and authenticate users in the XRP Ledger.
The XRP Ledger supports multiple types of cryptographic key pairs, including signing keys and seeding keys.
Each account in the XRP Ledger has a pair of master public/private keys, which are used for signing transactions.
Other types of keys, such as wallet or view-only keys, can also be associated with an account.
The XRP Ledger uses cryptographic methods to ensure the security and integrity of transactions.
limitations: The documentation is focused on explaining concepts rather than providing comprehensive technical details.
asserts: Cryptographic keys are essential for securing user identities and authenticating users in the XRP Ledger.
scope: The scope of this assertion is the context of cryptographic key usage within the XRP Ledger, including account creation, transaction signing, and authentication processes.
